scene: The droid's key unlocks transit portals across the yard!
picture: Flat side-view yard. Far left, a brass airship gondola floats with an open hatch ladder lowered. Left, the girl in teal hoodie and purple wheelchair clutches a brass key beside the cheerful yellow droid. Centre, a transparent cylindrical glass elevator stands with glowing doors open. Far right, a pink steam train sits ready.
shown: A moored brass airship ladder hangs waiting on the far left.
A transparent glass elevator shaft sits with open doors in the centre.
A puffing pink steam train engine stands waiting on the far right.
